اصطدما (form VIII)
# اِصْطَدَمَا (iṣṭadamā) /isˤ.tˤa.da.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اُصْطُدِمَا (uṣṭudimā) /usˤ.tˤu.di.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# اِصْطَدِمَا (iṣṭadimā) /isˤ.tˤa.di.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
